model.quantization: checkpoint mixed NVFP4/FP8; Flare SM70 BF16-value arithmetic
model.layer_pattern: three linear-attention layers followed by one full-attention layer

upstream.name: Lyra — neuron-explorer
upstream.credit: Neuron-by-neuron causal sweeps, signed relative doses, read/write comparison, and saved rollout exploration are inspired by Lyra's work. This integration is independently implemented; upstream code is not vendored.

interpretation.ipip: Prompt-conditioned model self-report; all 50 valid complete items required per seed.
interpretation.uncertainty: Across-seed sample SD, standard error and observed range are descriptive; three seeds do not establish population reliability.
interpretation.capability: Exact explicit final numeric answer only; explanations are not independently graded.
interpretation.heldout: Behavior prompts are held out from IPIP scoring; prompt-only results do not validate activation interventions.
interpretation.package: Manifest hash consistency is checked; on-disk package authenticity remains the launcher's responsibility.
